channelPartners.name: Skyline Realty Partners
channelPartners.tagline: Luxury residences specialist, Golf Course Road & Dwarka Expressway
channelPartners.bio: Skyline Realty Partners has closed over 300 transactions across Gurugram's premium micro-markets since 2016, with a focus on Golf Course Road Extension and Dwarka Expressway. The team works directly with a small set of RERA-certified developers rather than spreading thin across the market, so buyers get deep, current knowledge of each project's construction stage, inventory and pricing movement.

channelPartners.name: NorthStar Property Advisors
channelPartners.tagline: End-user homes, Sohna Road & New Gurugram
channelPartners.bio: NorthStar Property Advisors focuses on first-time and end-user buyers looking in Sohna Road and New Gurugram — helping compare configurations, possession timelines and home-loan eligibility across a handful of actively tracked projects, rather than pushing whichever project pays the highest commission.

channelPartners.name: Capital Square Realtors
channelPartners.bio: Capital Square Realtors has advised on real estate investment in Gurugram since 2013, with particular depth in NRI transactions and portfolio-style multi-unit purchases. Every project represented has been personally site-visited by the team before being added to their active list.

channelPartners.name: PrimeHome Consultants
channelPartners.bio: PrimeHome Consultants tracks new launches on Dwarka Expressway closely, often meeting buyers on-site during the pre-launch and early booking window when floor selection and payment plans are most flexible.

channelPartners.name: Urban Nest Advisory
channelPartners.tagline: Family homes, Golf Course Road & Sector 150
channelPartners.bio: Urban Nest Advisory works primarily with families relocating within or into Gurugram, with a preference for villa and independent-floor formats over high-rise apartments. The team offers site visits on weekends and coordinates directly with developer sales offices to speed up paperwork.
